segments.an6.29:1.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ āmantesi –
segments.an6.29:1.3: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī tuṇhī ahosi.
segments.an6.29:1.4: Dutiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ āmantesi –
segments.an6.29:1.6: Dutiyampi kho āyasmā udāyī tuṇhī ahosi.
segments.an6.29:1.7: Tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ āmantesi –
segments.an6.29:1.9: Tatiyampi kho āyasmā udāyī tuṇhī ahosi.
segments.an6.29:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.29:2.4: Idha, bhante, bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati – seyyathidaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo … pe …. Iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
segments.an6.29:3.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.an6.29:4.3: Idha, bhante, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi … pe … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.an6.29:4.4: Idaṃ, bhante, anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya saṃvattati.
segments.an6.29:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu ālokasaññaṃ manasi karoti, divā saññaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā;
segments.an6.29:5.2: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.an6.29:5.3: Idaṃ, bhante, anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ ñāṇadassanappaṭilābhāya saṃvattati.
segments.an6.29:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati –
segments.an6.29:6.2: ‘atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nhāru [nahāru (sī. pī.) dī. ni.2.377; ma. ni.1.110] aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttan’ti.
segments.an6.29:6.3: Idaṃ, bhante, anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ kāmarāgappahānāya saṃvattati.
segments.an6.29:7.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu seyyathāpi passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ [chaḍḍitaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] ekāhamataṃ vā dvīhamataṃ vā tīhamataṃ vā uddhumātakaṃ vinīlakaṃ vipubbakajātaṃ.
segments.an6.29:7.2: So imameva kāyaṃ evaṃ [evanti idaṃ satipaṭṭhānasuttādīsu natthi] upasaṃharati –
segments.an6.29:7.3: ‘ayampi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto’”ti [etaṃ anatītoti (sī.)].
segments.an6.29:8.1: “Seyyathāpi vā pana [seyyathā vā pana (syā.)] passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ kākehi vā khajjamānaṃ kulalehi vā khajjamānaṃ gijjhehi vā khajjamānaṃ sunakhehi vā khajjamānaṃ siṅgālehi [sigālehi (sī.)] vā khajjamānaṃ vividhehi vā pāṇakajātehi khajjamānaṃ.
segments.an6.29:9.1: “Seyyathāpi vā pana passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ nhārusambandhaṃ … pe … aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ nimmaṃsalohitamakkhitaṃ nhārusambandhaṃ … aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ apagatamaṃsalohitaṃ nhārusambandhaṃ.
segments.an6.29:9.4: Aṭṭhikāni apagatasambandhāni disāvidisāvikkhittāni [disāvidisāsu vikkhittāni (sī.)], aññena hatthaṭṭhikaṃ aññena pādaṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅghaṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūruṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭiṭṭhikaṃ [kaṭaṭṭhikaṃ (sī.)] aññena [piṭṭhikaṇḍakaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ (sī. pī.), piṭṭhikaṇḍakaṭṭhikaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ (syā. kaṃ.)] phāsukaṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṭṭhikaṃ aññena khandhaṭṭhikaṃ aññena gīvaṭṭhikaṃ aññena hanukaṭṭhikaṃ aññena dantakaṭṭhikaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ [piṭṭhikaṇḍakaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ (sī. pī.), piṭṭhikaṇḍakaṭṭhikaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ (syā. kaṃ.)], aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkhavaṇṇappaṭibhāgāni [saṅkhavaṇṇūpanibhāni (sī. syā. pī.)] aṭṭhikāni puñjakitāni [puñjakatāni (pī.)] terovassikāni aṭṭhikāni pūtīni cuṇṇakajātāni.
segments.an6.29:9.7: Idaṃ, bhante, anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ asmimānasamugghātāya saṃvattati.
segments.an6.29:10.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā … pe … catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.an6.29:10.2: Idaṃ, bhante, anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ anekadhātupaṭivedhāya saṃvattati.
segments.an6.29:11.2: Tena hi tvaṃ, ānanda, idampi chaṭṭhaṃ anussatiṭṭhānaṃ dhārehi.
segments.an6.29:11.3: Idhānanda, bhikkhu satova abhikkamati satova paṭikkamati satova tiṭṭhati satova nisīdati satova seyyaṃ kappeti satova kammaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
segments.an6.29:11.4: Idaṃ, ānanda, anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ satisampajaññāya saṃvattatī”ti.

lines: Suṇomahaṃ, āvusoti, āvuso, nāhaṃ badhiro, suṇāmi bhagavato vacanaṃ, pañhaṃ pana upaparikkhāmīti.
Yathā divā tathā rattinti yathānena divā ālokasaññā manasikatā, rattimpi tatheva taṃ manasi karoti.
Yathā rattiṃ tathā divāti yathā vānena rattiṃ ālokasaññā manasikatā, divāpi taṃ tatheva manasi karoti.
Sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāvetīti dibbacakkhuñāṇatthāya sahobhāsakaṃ cittaṃ brūheti vaḍḍheti.
Yaṃ pana “ālokasaññaṃ manasi karotī”ti vuttaṃ, taṃ thinamiddhavinodanālokasaññaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ, na dibbacakkhuñāṇālokanti veditabbaṃ.
Imameva kāyantiādīsu yaṃ vattabbaṃ siyā, taṃ sabbaṃ sabbākārena vitthārato visuddhimagge kāyagatāsatikammaṭṭhāne vuttaṃ.
Bhastā viya vāyunā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā yathānukkamaṃ samuggatena sūnabhāvena dhumātattā uddhumātaṃ, uddhumātameva uddhumātakaṃ.
Maṃsussadaṭṭhānesu rattavaṇṇassa pubbasannicayaṭṭhānesu setavaṇṇassa yebhuyyena ca nīlavaṇṇassa nīlaṭṭhāne nīlasāṭakapārutasseva chavasarīrassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
Paribhinnaṭṭhānehi navahi vā vaṇamukhehi vissandamānaṃ pubbaṃ vipubbaṃ, vipubbameva vipubbakaṃ.
So imameva kāyanti so bhikkhu imaṃ attano kāyaṃ tena kāyena saddhiṃ ñāṇena upasaṃharati upaneti.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – āyu usmā viññāṇanti imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ atthitāya ayaṃ kāyo ṭhānagamanādikhamo hoti, imesaṃ pana vigamā ayampi evaṃdhammo evaṃpūtikasabhāvoyevāti.
Khajjamānanti udarādīsu nisīditvā udaramaṃsaoṭṭhamaṃsaakkhikamaṃsādīni luñcitvā luñcitvā khādiyamānaṃ.
Nimmaṃsalohitamakkhitanti maṃse khīṇepi lohitaṃ na sussati, taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ –
Pūtīnīti abbhokāse ṭhitāni vātātapavuṭṭhisamphassena terovassikāneva pūtīni honti, antobhūmigatāni pana cirataraṃ tiṭṭhanti.
Sabbattha so imamevāti vuttanayena khajjamānādīnaṃ vasena yojanā kātabbā.
Iti imasmiṃ sutte satiñāṇāni missakāni kathitānīti.

lines: Navame diṭṭhadhammo vuccati paccakkho attabhāvoti āha “imasmiṃyeva attabhāve”ti.
Ālokasaññaṃ manasi karotīti sūriyacandapajjotamaṇiukkāvijjuādīnaṃ āloko divā rattiñca upaladdho, yathāladdhavaseneva ālokaṃ manasi karoti, citte ṭhapeti.
Tathā ca naṃ manasi karoti, yathāssa subhāvitālokakasiṇassa viya kasiṇāloko yathicchakaṃ yāvadicchakañca so āloko rattiyaṃ upatiṭṭhati.
Yena tattha divāsaññaṃ ṭhapeti, divāriva vigatathinamiddho hoti.
Divāti saññaṃ ṭhapetīti vuttanayena manasi katvā divāriva saññaṃ uppādeti.
Yathānena divā … pe … tatheva taṃ manasi karotīti yathānena divā upaladdho sūriyāloko, evaṃ rattimpi divā diṭṭhākāreneva taṃ ālokaṃ manasi karoti.
Yathā canena rattiṃ … pe … manasi karotīti yathā rattiyaṃ candāloko upaladdho, evaṃ divāpi rattiṃ diṭṭhākāreneva taṃ ālokaṃ manasi karoti, citte ṭhapeti.
Dibbacakkhuñāṇaṃ rūpagatassa dibbassa itarassa ca dassanaṭṭhena idha ñāṇadassananti adhippetanti āha “dibbacakkhusaṅkhātassā”tiādi.
Setarattehi viparibhinnaṃ vimissitaṃ nīlaṃ, purimavaṇṇavipariṇāmabhūtaṃ vā nīlaṃ vinīlaṃ, vinīlameva vinīlakanti ka-kārena padavaḍḍhanamāha anatthantarato yathā “pītakaṃ lohitakan”ti.
Kucchitaṃ vinīlaṃ vinīlakanti kucchanattho vā ayaṃ ka-kāroti dassetuṃ vuttaṃ yathā “pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchatī”ti (dī. ni.3.316; a. ni.5.213).
Vissandamānaṃ pubbanti vissavantapubbaṃ, tahaṃ tahaṃ paggharantapubbanti attho.
So bhikkhūti yo “passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitan”ti vutto, so bhikkhu.
Evaṃpūtikasabhāvoti evaṃ ativiya pūtisabhāvo āyuādivigame viyāti adhippāyo.
Ediso bhavissatīti evaṃbhāvīti āha “evamevaṃ uddhumātādibhedo bhavissatī”ti.
Sesāvasesamaṃsalohitayuttanti sabbaso akkhāditattā tahaṃ tahaṃ sesena appāvasesena maṃsalohitena yuttaṃ.
Aññena hatthaṭṭhikanti avisesena hatthaṭṭhikānaṃ vippakiṇṇatā jotitāti anavasesato tesaṃ vippakiṇṇataṃ dassento “catusaṭṭhibhedampī”tiādimāha.
Tāni pana saṃvaccharaṃ vītivattāni hontīti āha “atikkantasaṃvaccharānī”ti.
Satiyā ca ñāṇassa ca atthāyāti “abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hotī”tiādinā (dī. ni.1.214;2.376; ma. ni.1.109) vuttāya sattaṭṭhānikāya satiyā ceva taṃsampayuttañāṇassa ca atthāya.
